description: Procurement for the supply of empty LPG Cylinders without valves for Litro Gas Lanka Ltd.
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-12-22 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Litro Gas Lanka Limited has invited international competitive bids from the registered suppliers of the Sri Lanka Standards Institution for the purchase of 04 types of empty LPG cylinders without valves for the period of 2025-2027. 06 bids have been received for the same. Based on the recommendation submitted by the Standing High Level Procurement Committee upon evaluation of the said bids, the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Planning and Economic Development to award the procurement for the supply of 120,000 cylinders of 2.3 kg, 185,000 cylinders of  5 kg, 450,000 cylinders of 12.5 kg and 7,000 cylinders of 37.5 kg, for Litro Gas Company Limited, to the substantially responsive lowest bidder, M/s. Sahamitr Metal Pressure Containers Public Co. Ltd., was approved by the Cabinet.
